children: Most Gulf bourses closed lower on Sunday, with traders weighing the disruption in the Strait of Hormuz alongside Iran-aligned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia.
The Iranian navy has confirmed that a Saturday mine strike in the Strait of Hormuz set three oil tankers ablaze, state media reported.

On Sunday, the Saudi-led coalition confronting the Iran-backed Houthis announced that it had downed two ballistic missiles fired at the capital, Riyadh, along with three drones over the kingdom's oil-rich Eastern Province.
Houthi strikes on Saudi airports, seaports, and energy installations have intensified, and Riyadh has responded by expanding its air campaign against Houthi targets in Yemen.
